scope: Research bibliography of arXiv hep-th papers centrally developing or applying fortuity, plus selected direct precursors. Current arXiv titles and summaries, dated by first submission. Broader related literature remains selective.

papers.title: BPS Bootstrap
papers.summary: Applies the large-N matrix bootstrap to expectation values in heavy BPS states. Horizonless sectors yield broad allowed regions; preliminary results for the 1/16-BPS BMN sector explore the harder problem of isolating black-hole states.

papers.title: Fortuitous BMN Operators from Multiple Cores
papers.summary: Constructs fortuitous BMN operators from multiple lower-rank cores, with restriction maps establishing non-exactness and an explicit two-core SU(4) example.

papers.title: BPS Chaos and Fortuity in Higgs Branches I: The Gepner Point
papers.summary: Identifies pure-Higgs states as fortuitous cohomologies in quiver quantum mechanics and probes their chaos using Berry/Chern curvature at a Gepner point.

papers.title: Non-Coulomb Q-cohomology and quantum lifting
papers.summary: Studies non-Coulomb monotones and fortuitous lifting partners, deriving restrictions on one-loop quantum lifting and a discriminant-dressing no-hair relation.

papers.title: Fortuitous BMN Cohomology at Every N
papers.summary: Builds polynomial fortuitous BMN classes for every SU(N), N ≥ 3, from an SU(2) core and proves non-exactness through block restriction.

papers.title: Black hole cohomologies in N=4 SYM
papers.summary: Computes low-rank BMN cohomologies, finds surviving brane-fused families, and proposes a charge-conjugation parity criterion distinguishing black hole classes from gravitons.

papers.title: Random wave chaos on momentum-fractionated microstate geometries
papers.summary: Probes geodesic and wave chaos on fractionated superstrata and explores a possible relation between momentum fractionation and the monotone–fortuitous distinction.

papers.title: Fortuity on the conifold
papers.summary: Formulates Klebanov–Witten cohomology in the UV, refines monotonicity to accommodate baryons, and constructs fortuitous classes for SU(2) × SU(2).

papers.title: Fortuitous ABJM Operators as Black Holes
papers.summary: Follows fortuitous ABJM operator trajectories as rank varies and investigates their large-N limits, allowed graviton dressings, and near-BPS gaps.

papers.title: Fortuity and fragility in supersymmetric SYK
papers.summary: Quantifies the obstruction and metric cost of uplifting BPS representatives across SYK system sizes, relating this fragility to BPS chaos.

papers.title: Quantum black hole cohomologies
papers.summary: Examines quantum corrections to classical black hole cohomology, identifying both lifted and surviving fortuitous SU(2) classes.

papers.title: Fortuity beyond counting: an explicit construction
papers.summary: Constructs deformed K3-orbifold cohomologies explicitly and finds a three-point coupling connecting monotone and fortuitous sectors.

papers.title: Fortuity and Complexity in a Simple Quark Model
papers.summary: Extends the monotone–fortuitous distinction to BRST cohomology in a quark model and compares the counting and complexity of meson and baryon states.

papers.title: BPS spectra of Tr[Ψ^p] matrix models for odd p
papers.summary: Studies fermionic matrix models with odd-power supercharges, computing finite-rank BPS multiplicities and Hamiltonians. Rank projections define a stable-image test for fortuity; identification of particular classes is conditional on reported numerical vanishings at larger rank.

papers.title: Chaos of Berry curvature for BPS microstates
papers.summary: Uses non-Abelian Berry curvature to probe chaos inside degenerate BPS sectors. Computations in supersymmetric JT gravity and SYK show random-matrix behavior, contrasting with structured curvature for states associated with horizonless geometries.

papers.title: Secondary invariants and non-perturbative states
papers.summary: Examines finite-N invariant rings through their Hironaka decomposition. Simple matrix integrals illustrate a proposed interpretation of primary invariants as perturbative degrees of freedom and secondary invariants as distinguished nonperturbative sectors.

papers.title: The Resolved Elliptic Genus and the D1-D5 CFT
papers.summary: Develops the resolved elliptic genus using Schur–Weyl duality and a proposed superselection rule for BPS lifting. The refined index separates black-hole microstate sectors hidden by the modified elliptic genus and discusses applications to fortuity.

papers.title: Fortuitous Chaos, BPS Black Holes, and Random Matrices
papers.summary: Develops a random-matrix model motivated by fortuitous BPS chaos and its connection with supersymmetric JT gravity.

papers.title: Two roads to fortuity in ABJM theory
papers.summary: Enumerates low-lying fortuitous operators in weakly coupled ABJM and transfers an infinite BMN cohomology tower through a matching supercharge truncation.

papers.title: Fortuity and relevant deformation
papers.summary: Tracks supercharge cohomology under a relevant deformation of N=4 SYM and shows how the deformation can turn monotone UV classes into fortuitous ones.

papers.title: Fortuity in ABJM
papers.summary: Constructs fortuitous ABJM cohomologies at small rank, including additional states in monopole sectors at Chern–Simons level k = 2.

papers.title: To gauge or to double gauge? Matrix models, global symmetry, and black hole cohomologies
papers.summary: Projects BMN cohomology onto R-symmetry singlets to isolate much of the non-graviton spectrum and obtain a closed SU(3) singlet index.

papers.title: Fortuity and R-charge concentration in the D1-D5 CFT
papers.summary: Constructs explicit fortuitous cohomology classes at N=2 and N=3 in the D1–D5 CFT. Their representation content motivates a conjecture linking the largest symmetry representations to fortuity and gives evidence for R-charge concentration.

papers.title: Konishi lifts a black hole
papers.summary: Shows that the quantum-corrected supercharge pairs and lifts an extra monotone–fortuitous pair in SO(7), using the generalized Konishi anomaly.

papers.title: BPS phases and fortuity in higher spin holography
papers.summary: Studies BPS bound states and a new finite-rank operator in vector Chern–Simons theory, alongside large-N index phases relevant to higher-spin black holes.

papers.title: Fortuity with a single matrix
papers.summary: Presents an exactly solvable supersymmetric quantum mechanics with one adjoint fermionic matrix and many fortuitous states. Exact finite-N calculations and a unitary matrix integral make the sensitive dependence on rank directly accessible.

papers.title: Violation of S-duality in classical Q-cohomology
papers.summary: Finds a monotone–fortuitous pair that obstructs classical cohomology matching between S-dual theories, challenging one-loop exactness of the BPS spectrum.

papers.title: A New Supersymmetry Index for the D1-D5 CFT
papers.summary: Introduces a refined supersymmetry index for the T4 D1–D5 CFT. It matches supergravity below the black-hole threshold and resolves microstate sectors above it; the longer companion paper develops its connection to fortuity.

papers.title: Probing Non-Graviton Spectra in N=4 SYM via BMN truncation and S-Duality
papers.summary: Computes exact low-rank BMN indices and uses discrepancies between S-dual truncations to identify non-graviton cohomologies.

papers.title: Fortuity and Supergravity
papers.summary: Includes singleton states in the monotone supergravity spectrum and constructs explicit fortuitous states for Sym²(K3). The revised classification treats singletons as monotone.

papers.title: Bosonic Fortuity in Vector Models
papers.summary: Uses invariant theory in matrix–vector systems to identify secondary invariants and proposes a bosonic analogue of fortuity.

papers.title: Fortuity in the D1-D5 system
papers.summary: Formulates D1–D5 lifting as a cohomology problem, constructs low-rank classes, and develops the monotone–fortuitous classification for symmetric orbifolds.

papers.title: Brane-fused black hole operators
papers.summary: Constructs new cohomologies by fusing lower-rank black hole cores with dual giant graviton hair and studies associated partial no-hair behavior.

papers.title: Fortuity in SYK Models
papers.summary: Studies fortuity in supersymmetric SYK, relating charge concentration and random-matrix behavior to a proposed supercharge-chaos principle.

papers.title: BPS Chaos
papers.summary: Applies the LMRS diagnostic to BPS sectors and argues that fortuity can preserve the strong chaos expected of finite-area black hole microstates.

papers.title: Holographic covering and the fortuity of black holes
papers.summary: Introduces the monotone–fortuitous classification through supercharge cohomology and proposes its relation to horizonless geometries and typical black hole microstates.

papers.title: Finite N black hole cohomologies
papers.summary: Constructs and counts finite-rank non-graviton BMN cohomologies, including an SU(3) threshold operator and towers with partial no-hair behavior.

papers.title: Following Black Hole States
papers.summary: Follows a light black hole operator continuously in rank, exposing how a generically non-BPS trajectory becomes BPS at a special finite N.

papers.title: Towards quantum black hole microstates
papers.summary: Constructs an infinite tower of SU(2) non-graviton cohomologies and identifies forbidden graviton dressings, establishing partial no-hair behavior in the BMN sector.

papers.title: Words to describe a black hole
papers.summary: Identifies SU(2) BPS states beyond the multi-graviton spectrum, providing an early constructive foundation for later studies of fortuitous cohomology.
